surprising: Spreadsheet work has explicit correctness friction in three of four relevant entries, despite involving routine formula and total checks: incorrect aggregation, formula defects with duplicated totals, and incorrect cell referencing.

recommended.reason: Structured formula editing and verification address the reported calculation and reference errors.
Integrity checks on tabular data address duplicate totals and calculation consistency before reporting.

headline: Writing: Covered. Spreadsheet work: Critical.
strongestBasis: Writing has four relevant entries and no explicit friction. Covered indicates observed task coverage without reported friction, not demonstrated successful performance. The strongest designation is relative to this sample only.

methodology.unit: One blank-line-separated request equals one entry.

ratingRules.Critical: At least three relevant entries, at least two with explicit friction, and a friction rate of at least one half.
ratingRules.Weak: At least three relevant entries, at least one with explicit friction, and a friction rate of at least one quarter, below Critical.
ratingRules.Developing: At least two relevant entries with explicit friction, below Weak and Critical.
ratingRules.Covered: At least two relevant entries and no explicit friction; this is coverage, not verified competence.

methodology.classificationNote: Checking arithmetic totals is spreadsheet validation, not research verification. A generic bug-fix request alone does not establish agent-caused failure.
limitations: Results describe the supplied sample, not the model’s intelligence.
Requests provide reported friction, not independently verified failures or successful outcomes.
Task frequency alone does not establish strength or weakness.
Recommendations are relevant to observed gaps, not confirmed missing installations.
